description: Source code for the SetExam page in an online examination system, handling UI interactions for selecting courses, adding questions, and setting up exams. Contains event handlers for UI controls like buttons and dropdowns, database operations for managing questions and exam details.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing the 'Set Exam' page with event handlers for user interactions and database operations related to questions and exams.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently, it has commented-out code for session-based question count.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester with a list of courses.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input text boxes related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new multiple-choice question into the database, then updates the question number based on database count.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry in the database for the selected course and exam number, then navigates to admin panel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Fetches the current question count for the selected course and displays the next question number.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to login page.
